topics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

outcomes.text: I can name different parts of the body and describe physical characteristics that make us unique.
I can distinguish different body parts, including main organs of the body, and tell what those parts do.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate healthy relationships and interaction with others, utilize effective communication skills (verbal, non-verbal, and online), and differentiate between healthy and unhealthy behaviors, and how those behaviors impact relationships with peers and adults

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate healthy relationships and interaction with others, utilize effective communication skills (verbal, non-verbal, and online), and differentiate between healthy and unhealthy behaviors, and how those behaviors impact relationships with peers and adults

outcomes.text: I can demonstrate a respect of personal space for myself and others.
I can recognize different emotions and respond to others as needed.
I can demonstrate respect for peers and adults through appropriate communication.
I can identify different emotions and illustrate how to interact with others in different settings.

topics.title: Students will apply concepts of how food choices impact the overall health of self and others, and investigate how different types of eating disorders damage body systems

subtopics.title: Students will apply concepts of how food choices impact the overall health of self and others, and investigate how different types of eating disorders damage body systems

outcomes.text: I can identify and choose healthy snacks.
I can identify the food groups and discuss the importance of choosing foods from each group.

topics.title: Students will investigate healthy and unhealthy behaviors related to alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs, while understanding the physical, psychological, and legal consequences for self and others

subtopics.title: Students will investigate healthy and unhealthy behaviors related to alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs, while understanding the physical, psychological, and legal consequences for self and others

outcomes.text: I can discuss appropriate use of medications, including taking medicine from reliable adults and following directions.
I can identify the effects of alcohol and tobacco use that make them harmful to self and others.

topics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

subtopics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

outcomes.text: I can identify the role of germs in causing disease and demonstrate ways to prevent spreading them.
I can identify safety hazards and demonstrate ways to prevent harm to self and others.
I can identify various emotions and how they impact me.
I can discuss the relationship between personal hygiene, wellness, and disease prevention.
I can demonstrate safety procedures for emergencies at home or at school.
I can recognize the relationship between my emotions and the emotions of others.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

outcomes.text: I can classify the major functions of the body systems, identify which body parts are in each system, and how to keep my body systems healthy.
I can distinguish how the body systems mature and how heredity impacts growth and development.

outcomes.text: I can demonstrate appropriate verbal and nonverbal communication skills.
I can compare behaviors that demonstrate respect as well as disrespect of self and others.
I can predict consequences of healthy and unhealthy behaviors, including their impact on self and others.
I can effectively communicate my thoughts and opinions to my peers in a healthy manner.

outcomes.text: I can make healthy food choices based on nutritional information.

subtopics.title: Students will investigate healthy and unhealthy behaviors related to alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs, while understanding the physical, psychological, and legal consequences for self and others

outcomes.text: I can discuss avoidance strategies for alcohol, tobacco, and other drug use.

topics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

subtopics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

outcomes.text: I can develop strategies for lifetime behavior and activity that promote health and wellness.
I can identify people and resources that promote health and safety.
I can identify behaviors associated with physical, mental, and verbal abuse and resources that aid in avoiding them.
I can recognize potentially abusive situations as a threat to personal safety.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

outcomes.text: I can demonstrate an understanding of how different body systems interact and depend on each other.
I can analyze more advanced body systems and the function that they play in overall health.
I can analyze and discuss physical and emotional changes that occur during puberty and the physical changes that occur within body systems as I mature.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate healthy relationships and interaction with others, utilize effective communication skills (verbal, non-verbal, and online), and differentiate between healthy and unhealthy behaviors, and how those behaviors impact relationships with peers and adults

outcomes.text: I can evaluate how inappropriate and risky behaviors as well as poor communication may have negative consequences in relationships.
I can identify the dangers and consequences of inappropriate use of technology and social media.
I can analyze the impact of behaviors and communication on relationships.

outcomes.text: I can analyze the misuse of and dependency on alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs and identify support and resources for treatment.

topics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

subtopics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

outcomes.text: I can monitor personal feelings and stress and identify strategies, skills, and resources that assist in managing them.
I can examine personal feelings and stress that can be a threat to personal safety.
I can identify strategies to avoid risk associated with communicable diseases.
I can show/model a knowledge of first aid and appropriate response in emergency situations.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate the ability to apply their understanding of human growth and development, including awareness of their own and others’, related to body systems

outcomes.text: I can analyze growth patterns and developmental changes and examine the factors that interfere with healthy development.
I can examine factors that are important to human reproduction, including prenatal care, pregnancy, and childbirth, and identify available health resources.

outcomes.text: I can analyze behaviors and attitudes that contribute to healthy relationships.

subtopics.title: Students will apply concepts of how food choices impact the overall health of self and others, and investigate how different types of eating disorders damage body systems

outcomes.text: I can evaluate personal eating habits and patterns for the purpose of determining how I can live a healthy lifestyle as it relates to nutrition.

topics.title: Students will investigate healthy and unhealthy behaviors related to alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs, while understanding the physical, psychological, and legal consequences for self and others

outcomes.text: I can describe the effects of the use of alcohol, tobacco, and other drugs.

topics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

subtopics.title: Students will promote physical, social, and emotional health for self and others

outcomes.text: I can make choices in different situations that contribute to the overall health of self and others.
I can demonstrate an understanding of basic first aid including hands-on CPR, bleeding control, and the use of an AED.
I can demonstrate an understanding of different procedures and resources that contribute to the health and safety of self and others.

topics.title: Students will demonstrate understanding of health promotion (physical, social, and emotional) by applying research-related concepts to disease prevention, safety, and advocating for the health and well-being of self and others

subtopics.title: Students will demonstrate understanding of health promotion (physical, social, and emotional) by applying research-related concepts to disease prevention, safety, and advocating for the health and well-being of self and others

outcomes.text: I can compare and contrast different methods of disease transmission and prevention, including foodborne illnesses, STDs, and other communicable diseases.
I can analyze the impact of different communicable and non-communicable diseases on the overall health of self and others.

topics.title: Students will understand the components related to mental and emotional health and analyze related behaviors

subtopics.title: Students will understand the components related to mental and emotional health and analyze related behaviors

outcomes.text: I can recognize the importance of good mental health and how it relates and contributes to all other aspects of health.
I can demonstrate skills and strategies that promote personal and mental health.
